capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: 66.5 kWh gross (BMW global: energy content 66.45 kWh).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs quoting the MINI US spec sheet: 64.7 kWh usable (ArenaEV 64.6). 2025-2027 compared: no US pack change found.

preconditioning.notes: Motoring File: "MINI's app-based pre-conditioning improves charging speed and extends battery life" (app-triggered; no navigation trigger mentioned). Not read on a MINI page; the Cars.com piece mentions only cabin pre-conditioning.

dc_max_kw.notes: MINI USA: fast charging with DC at up to 130 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Motoring File: onboard AC charger up to 11 kW (ArenaEV lists 22 kW three-phase capability, which the car limits to 11 kW). InsideEVs 9.6 kW is the test charger, not the onboard charger. US/Canada onboard figure not read on a MINI page.

published_10_80_min.notes: InsideEVs: 10-80 % in 29 min according to MINI (MINI US: "just under 30 minutes").
